Nicecard

A Webflow landing page for a fictional credit card, in the dark variant of the style.

Source
nicecard (Webflow)
Style
Neumorphism (agent-proposed, not yet reviewed by a person)
Moods
Premium, tactile
Evidence
Captured with tools/capture.mjs (headless Chrome, 1440 × 900) on 28 September 2026 and inspected. The screenshot shows the first viewport; the measurement covers up to four screens. A “Made in Webflow” badge sits at the lower right.
Reviewed
28 September 2026
Rights
Third-party work, stored with credit for commentary. License: unverified. Rights policy

Observed

  • A charcoal page. “The future of credit cards is nice ;)” is set in large bold orange sans-serif; the body is lorem ipsum.
  • Navigation pills (Home, Features, Pricing) and the “View pricing” button are charcoal on charcoal with a faint light edge and a dark shadow; “Home” has an orange outline.
  • “Discover features” is an orange gradient pill. White App Store and Google Play badges sit below.
  • Three 3D credit cards (black, silver, orange) float at the right with glossy highlights.

Why it belongs

Evidence for the dark variant on the web, comparable to the CRED app. The measurement finds outlines on most boxes, so the fingerprint rejects it.

Measured: shadows on 37 % of boxes (median offset 5.7 px, median blur 6 px, none hard), borders on 82 %, median radius 0 px.
